1. **(Z)-1-chloro-2-methylbut-1-ene**: Has a double bond with Z geometry but no chiral center; it is achiral. No optical activity.

4. **(2R,3R)-2,3-dimethylsuccinic acid**: A single enantiomer with two chiral centers of the same configuration; chiral and optically active.
5. **(R)-cyclohex-3-en-1-ol**: Contains one chiral center (R); chiral and optically active.
6. **(1s,3s,5s)-cyclohexane-1,3,5-triol**: All three OH groups on the same side; the molecule has a plane of symmetry and is meso; optically inactive.
7. **1-cyclopentyl-3-methylbutan-1-one**: No chiral centers (the carbon bearing the methyl has two identical methyl groups); achiral.
